name: Pip
subtitle: Pip, the money tracker with a coin mascot
description: Add this source to install Pip and get its updates.

apps.name: Pip
apps.subtitle: Track spending with Pip
apps.localizedDescription: Log what you spend in seconds, keep a daily streak, and see where your money goes. Pip cheers you on.
apps.versionDescription:
Everything in one update:
- Faster logging: say "Log coffee in Pip" to Siri, a Quick log widget for your Home Screen, a Lock Screen widget with what's left, and a Control Center button that opens the keypad.
- Who owes who: lend, borrow or split a bill with friends, with reminders and one-tap paybacks.
- Wallets: keep cash, card and savings apart, and move money between them without it counting as spending.
- Round-ups: every purchase rounds up and the spare change goes into a goal you pick.
Also includes everything from 1.3 to 1.6: limits, backups, bills calendar, your own categories, dark mode, receipt photos and badges.
